name: Yahata Shiho
source:
A senior student to [url=https://vndb.org/c62812]Rin Hoshina[/url]. She has a supportive personality and is the first student that Hoshina tells about his medical affliction that is changing his sex.

[spoiler]She is also possessive; if Hoshina pursues a romance with her, she locks him up in a room so that she can always be with him.[/spoiler]
